verdict.rationale: Check's own docs cover creating and paying employees through payroll objects, creating contractors with their payment methods, and producing tax documents for both. One platform view also shows what is blocking payroll across employees and contractors. missing for 10: explicit documentation of a single payroll run combining W-2 employees and 1099 contractor payments, explicit 1099/W-2 form filing detail, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can pay both W-2 employees and 1099 contractors from one platform
